Package Manager: Android app stores (Google Play, Samsung Galaxy Store)
Date of Discovery: May 23, 2023 (Signal Plus Messenger removal from Google Play)
Method of Attack: Trojanized versions of Signal and Telegram apps containing BadBazaar spyware
Tracking device location, stealing call logs, SMS, recording calls, taking pictures, exfiltrating contacts and files
FlyGram sends Telegram communication data to attacker-controlled server via backup feature
Signal Plus Messenger abuses Signal's QR-code linking feature to link attacker devices to victim's Signal account without victim knowledge, enabling spying on future messages
Impacted Systems: Android devices using Signal and Telegram apps
Users in Ukraine, Poland, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Germany, Hong Kong, United States
Attack Vector: Trojanized apps uploaded to Google Play and Samsung Galaxy Store
Dedicated malicious websites (signalplus[.]org and flygram[.]org) offering app installation links
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of FlyGram and Signal Plus Messenger apps on Google Play and Samsung Galaxy Store
Backup feature enabled by at least 13,953 FlyGram users
QR-code linking abuse in Signal Plus Messenger
